name: bavard
author: Project Stump
license: MIT (code); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (the Molière corpus in tools/)
description: A bot that never stops talking, to test a Stump's guardrails for days. Alone, it posts unique lines of numbers with the date and time; when it finds another Bavard on another Stump, the two play Molière in the original French, turn by turn.
credits: Molière's plays (public domain), from the Théâtre Classique editions (theatre-classique.fr) as encoded by FreDraCor (github.com/dracor-org/fredracor), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
